design: Extend an existing MapLibre animal-community map. Permanent membership is an explicit entity-to-animal-ID relation. Geographic clusters contain entity IDs and change with zoom. Proximity is a separate geodesic radius query around a selected entity, manually chosen point, or privately granted device location. All animal totals deduplicate IDs across memberships and independent sightings. Verified positive contribution events form a separate record from welfare reports: positive activity never cancels an unresolved corroborated concern. New reports and evidence are private; only authorized reviewers may publish generalized summaries. Submitted allegations never affect contribution scores. Game Kibble/facts are excluded from verified platform reputation. Public map data omits exact private coordinates and private evidence. Existing provider, styles and room permissions are preserved.
